name: UCM style (Kent State University)
about: AP style with Kent State university style overriding it. Each rule: id, pattern (regular expression), message, optional fix. Rules without a fix are flagged only. Edit freely; Proof reloads this file when it changes.

rules.message: Avoid "KSU." Use "Kent State University" on first reference, then "Kent State" or "the university."
Use "and," not "&," except in the proper name of an outside organization.
Say "Kent Campus," never "Kent State campus."
The building is the "Kent Student Center."
Kent State says "first-year student," not "freshman."
Kent State says "first-year students," not "freshmen."
Teams are the Golden Flashes, then Flashes. Never "Lady Flashes."
Use alumnus, alumna, alumni or graduate, never "alum."
Write "May 4" (May 4, 1970 on first reference), never "May 4th."
Use "Warren Student Recreation and Wellness Center," never "Rec."
Use "Memorial Athletic and Convocation Center," then "the center" or "MAC Center." Never "MACC."
UCM style drops the serial comma before "and" unless it's needed for clarity.
AP abbreviates January with a specific date: "Jan."
AP abbreviates February with a specific date: "Feb."
AP abbreviates August with a specific date: "Aug."
AP abbreviates September with a specific date: "Sept."
AP abbreviates October with a specific date: "Oct."
AP abbreviates November with a specific date: "Nov."
AP abbreviates December with a specific date: "Dec."
AP abbreviates this month with a period before a date.
AP writes September as "Sept." before a date.
AP writes September as "Sept." before a date.
AP spells out March, even with a date.
AP spells out April, even with a date.
AP spells out June, even with a date.
AP spells out July, even with a date.
AP dates use numerals without st, nd, rd or th.
Kent State uses "theatre" unless an official name uses -er.
